annotations.title: Search Price Paid Transactions by Postcode

description:
Search HM Land Registry Price Paid Index by postcode or address.

Returns up to 10 recent sale transactions for the postcode: price,
date, address, property type, and tenure (Freehold/Leasehold).
Covers England and Wales only. Postcode gives the most reliable
results — a full address is also accepted and the postcode is
extracted automatically.

address_or_postcode.description: UK property address or postcode. Postcode is most reliable: e.g. 'NG1 1AB'. Full address also accepted.

name: land_title_search

outputSchema.description: HMLR Price Paid Index search result for a given postcode.

postcode.description: Normalised UK postcode extracted from the input.

total.description: Number of Price Paid transactions returned. Capped at 10 by the upstream SPARQL query.

transactions.description: Recent Price Paid transactions for the postcode, sorted newest first.

items.description: A single Price Paid transaction for a property.

paon.description: Primary addressable object name (house number or name).

property_type.description: Property type label extracted from the HMLR URI (e.g. 'Terraced', 'Semi Detached', 'Flat').

title: Search Price Paid Transactions by Postcode
